10501.name: Further On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies Riding Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Entering Quickstream.

10501.description:
The current has the boat now, carrying it along between low banks of
white dunes at the pace of a trotting horse, and steering is all the
oars are good for. The water runs smooth and dark down the middle of the
channel, but along its edges it breaks into little curling waves. Back
west, against the stream, lies the mouth of Quickstream and the calm
sea; east the channel runs on, faster.

10502.name: Riding Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Further On Quickstream.

10502.description:
Quickstream runs like a mill-race here, and the dunes on either bank go
racing past as the boat rides its broad, humped back. Spray flies from
the bow in sheets, and the roar of the water fills your ears. Driftwood
shoots along beside you, keeping pace. The current hurries on east, and
west lies a hard, slow pull back against the stream.

10503.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Riding Quickstream.

10503.description:
A row of standing waves stretches across the stream here, great green
humps of water that never move however fast the current pours through
them, and the boat bucks over them one after another like a horse taking
fences. Every landing throws a bucketful of cold spray over the gunwale.
The water rushes on east, and west lies the way back, a hard fight
upstream.

10504.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10504.description:
The stream bends here around a bank of crumbling clay, and the whole
current piles up against the outer side in a hump of brown water before
swinging away, dragging the boat with it. Chunks of clay drop from the
bank and are swallowed with a plop. Downstream to the east the channel
straightens; upstream to the west the standing waves heave and glitter.

10505.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10505.description:
A great black rock stands in the middle of the stream here, and the
water piles against it in a roaring cushion of white before tearing past
on either side. The boat is flung by so close that you could almost
touch its weed-slick flank. East, the current races on; west, upstream,
the bend in the clay bank is already almost out of sight.

10506.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10506.description:
The roar of Quickstream is deafening here, and its edges are torn into
whirlpools that spin and suck and vanish, each one a little funnel of
glassy water. The boat shudders as the current shoves at it from below.
Spray hangs over the stream in a fine, drifting rain, and the sun
strikes little rainbows from it. The water rushes on east; west lies the
black rock in midstream.

10507.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10507.description:
The banks open out a little here into low dunes tufted with silver
grass, and a line of old marker posts stands along one shore, leaning
with the current, each topped with a scrap of faded rag. The stream runs
fast and smooth, a sheet of dark green glass that hisses along the hull.
East, the dunes rise higher where the channel narrows; west, the
whirlpools churn.

10508.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10508.description:
Two horns of black rock close in on the stream here, and Quickstream
crowds between them, heaped high in the middle and boiling white along
their feet. The roar echoes back from the rock walls, and the air is
cold with spray. The boat is shot through the gap toward the east as if
fired from a sling, while west the channel widens between low dunes.

10509.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies Into the Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10509.description:
Below the rocky gap the stream runs broad and swift between the last of
the dunes, and the air changes, cool and huge and heavy with the smell
of the open ocean. Ahead to the east, beyond a line of white breakers,
the Southern Ocean spreads away to the horizon. West, the black horns of
rock guard the narrows, still roaring.

10510.name: Into the Southern Ocean

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream in the Southern Ocean.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10510.description:
Quickstream bursts out of its channel here into the open Southern Ocean,
and where the racing current meets the incoming swell the sea stands up
in steep, confused peaks that crash together and fling spray high into
the air. The boat pitches wildly, shipping water over both gunwales.
East, the current runs on as a dark road through the ocean; west lies
the mouth of the channel between the dunes.

10511.name: On Quickstream in the Southern Ocean

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Into the Southern Ocean.

10511.description:
Out on the open ocean Quickstream runs on like a river within the sea, a
broad band of darker, smoother water edged on both sides by wavering
lines of foam. Outside those lines the ocean swells roll slow and blue,
but inside them the boat speeds along as if pulled on a rope. East, the
current heads toward a smudge of smoke on the horizon; west, the
breakers churn where it left the land.

10512.name: On Quickstream

north.description: To the north lies Entering a Volcanic Island.

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream in the Southern Ocean.

10512.description:
A volcanic island rises from the sea north of the current here, a dark
cone wreathed in drifting smoke, its lower slopes shaggy with green and
its shore a jagged ring of black rock. No boat can reach it, for reefs
of black lava lie all around it just under the water, and the surf boils
white over them in an unbroken wall. The air smells of sulphur, and fine
grey ash speckles the water. Quickstream sweeps on east, and back west
toward the open ocean.

extra_descs.island volcano cone reefs smoke:
Now and then the cone gives a low grumble that you feel through the
planks more than hear, and a fresh puff of smoke rolls from its crest.
Along the reefs the surf has thrown up drifts of grey pumice that bob in
the shallows like scum on a cooking pot.

10513.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10513.description:
The water here is warm to the touch and faintly cloudy, stained by ash
drifting out from the burning island, and a scum of grey pumice rides
along with the current. The sulphur stink lingers on the wind. Now and
then a hiss and a gout of steam rise from the sea far off, where some
hidden vent meets the water. The current carries the boat briskly on
east, while west the smoking cone stands up out of the sea.

10514.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10514.description:
Quickstream runs fast and straight here across the open ocean, and the
boat skims along it with a long, hissing wake spreading behind. Spray
whips back over the bow, salty and cold, and the wind of your passage
tugs at your hair. Ahead to the east, a dark headland is lifting out of
the sea, while west the current runs back toward the island's drifting
ash.

10515.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies Passing by Cape Voogk.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10515.description:
The water darkens to a cold slate-grey here, and the air takes on a bite
that numbs the fingers on the oars. Ahead to the east, the black
headland of Cape Voogk rises ever higher out of the sea, its cliffs
crusted with old snow, and pale shapes of ice drift along its foot.
Quickstream runs swift and silent, a smooth dark road with the foam
lines peeling away on either side. West, it runs back toward warmer
water.

10516.name: Passing by Cape Voogk

east.description: To the east lies Heading East On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10516.description:
Quickstream sweeps past the black headland of Cape Voogk here, so close
that the boom of the swell against its cliffs drowns out the hiss of the
current. The cliffs rise sheer and dark, glazed with ice where the spray
reaches and hung with long icicles, and on the crag at the very tip a
cairn of stones and whale bones stands against the sky. East, the
current runs on past the cape; west lies the way back along the stream.

extra_descs.cairn crag cape voogk bones:
The cairn on the crag is built of black stones and great curved whale
ribs, lashed together and frozen solid. From the current it looks like a
hand raised in warning, and sailors riding Quickstream past the cape
raise a hand back to it, for luck.

10517.name: Heading East On Quickstream

north.description: To the north lies The Ocean Stream near the Rim of the World.

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Passing by Cape Voogk.

10517.description:
Beyond the cape Quickstream swings back into open water and runs on
east, broad and steady. North, a second current splits away from it, a
narrow, fast-running stream that sailors say flows toward the very rim
of the world, but a line of white breakers seethes across its mouth over
some hidden bar, and behind them a wall of grey fog closes the way.
West, the black cliffs of Cape Voogk are falling behind, and the cold is
easing.

10518.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies Heading East On Quickstream.

10518.description:
The current is still strong here, but its roar has softened to a long,
steady hiss, and the swells of the open ocean have grown longer and
lazier on either side. The water warms again, blue-green and clear, and
the boat glides more than it races. Drifts of brown weed caught in the
stream travel along beside you like companions. The way runs on east,
and back west toward the cape.

10519.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies On Quickstream.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10519.description:
Quickstream widens and spreads here, its edges blurring into the
surrounding sea, and the foam lines that marked it begin to wander and
break apart. The surface is crinkled with countless small ripples that
glitter like fish scales. The boat is still carried along, though gently
now, and you can hear the water lapping at the hull again. East, the
current loosens further; west, it runs back stronger.

10520.name: On Quickstream

east.description: To the east lies Quickstream Fading.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10520.description:
The ocean grows quiet around the boat here, and Quickstream is now only
a gentle drift that you feel more than see, a slight lean of the water
toward the east. Long, low swells lift and lower you with sleepy
patience. A great calm is spreading over the sea ahead, where the water
lies like polished glass. West, the current runs back toward the wider
stream.

10521.name: Quickstream Fading

east.description: To the east lies Quickstream Faded.

west.description: To the west lies On Quickstream.

10521.description:
Here the last strength of Quickstream ebbs away into slow, wandering
eddies that turn the boat lazily about, and weed and foam carried all
the way from Mira Retrum spread out and come to rest on the still water.
The silence after the roar of the current is almost startling. East, the
sea lies utterly calm; west, the faint drift of the stream can still be
felt.

10522.name: Quickstream Faded

west.description: To the west lies Quickstream Fading.

10522.description:
Quickstream has faded away entirely here, and the boat floats on a wide,
still sea under an enormous sky, without a breath of current to carry it
anywhere. The water is clear blue and so calm that it mirrors every
cloud. All around lies the empty ocean, without a sail, a shore or a
bird in sight. The only way on is to row back west, against the dying
drift of the stream.

641500.name: fish flying silver
641500.long_desc: A flying fish bursts from the stream and skims alongside the boat on outspread silver fins.
641500.description:
It is a slender, blue-backed fish about as long as your forearm, with a
silver belly and two enormous fins that spread like the wings of a
dragonfly, stiff and glassy and finely veined. It shoots out of the
water at the speed of the current and glides for long stretches before
slapping back in. Sailors say they bring luck to any boat they follow,
and good eating besides.

641501.name: shark grey stray
641501.long_desc: A stray shark circles the boat, its grey fin slicing back and forth through the water.
641501.description:
It is a lean grey shark longer than the boat, its back scarred by old
wounds and its blunt snout probing at anything that trails in the water.
It has learned to follow boats down Quickstream for the scraps thrown
overboard, and lately it has grown bolder and hungrier. A frayed loop of
red cord hangs snagged among its back teeth, all that remains of some
sailor's charm.

741500.name: charm fin flying fish
741500.room_desc: A stiff, glassy fish fin lies here, spread like a little wing.
741500.description: A flying fish's long wing-fin, stiff and glassy and veined like a dragonfly's wing. Sailors thread such fins on a cord and wear them for luck, swearing that whoever does so will skim over any sea that tries to swallow them, and it does seem to make the wearer a little lighter on their feet.
